Investment Associate
 RemoteUnited States
 **** Cover Letter not required. But if you want to submit something, add something that shows who you are!****
 About MCJ
 MCJ is an early-stage venture capital firm supporting startups overriding critical bottlenecks in the physical economy — challenges made urgent by climate change, rising AI demand, and increasing geopolitical tensions. We focus on energy, infrastructure, and industrials, backing founders that see the next system first.
 The Role
 We’re hiring an Associate to join the MCJ investment team. This role will drive and scale MCJ’s sourcing engine. You’ll build and run the systems that find the earliest, most interesting founders in energy, infrastructure resilience, and industrial automation. You will also own thematic research end-to-end, and lean in on diligence work across our investment portfolio. You will be on the forefront of building AI tools and workflows that make MCJ faster and sharper.
 What You’ll Do
 Sourcing & Pipeline (50%)
 • Own MCJ’s proactive sourcing motion across our three mandates: firm power, operate-under-stress infrastructure, and industrial throughput
• Monitor research labs, DOE/ARPA-E grants, patent filings, university spinouts, and founder activity for pre-company and stealth-stage signals
• Build and maintain thematic pipeline maps (e.g. “every team working on microgrids,” “distributed energy storage networks”) and keep them current as the landscape shifts
• Run first conversations with founders and represent MCJ credibly in early outreach
 Tooling & Systems (25%)
 • Design and maintain the AI-enabled workflows that power sourcing and diligence — using tools like Claude, Harmonic, and others to structure messy datasets, monitor signals at scale, and cut manual research time
• Build lightweight internal tools/scripts/prompts that the investment team can reuse (e.g. competitive landscape generators, memo templates, screening frameworks)
• Start and scale lists, saved searches, and CRM pipeline data clean, current, and genuinely useful — not just maintained for its own sake
• Continuously evaluate new AI/data tools and bring the ones worth adopting into the team’s workflow
 Diligence Support (25%)
 • Partner with GPs on diligence for companies that clear the top of the funnel: market sizing, competitive landscape, reference calls, and technical/founder background checks
• Write clear internal memos on emerging themes, founder backgrounds, market shifts, and specific deal opportunities
• Help prepare materials for investment decision discussions and contribute a point of view, not just data
 Who You Are
 • Can be new to venture capital and startup operations in a professional capacity but have been following the space closely out of personal interest
• Technical background (CS, data engineering, physics, energy systems, materials science)
• Deeply involved in your university’s climate or energy clubs/groups as well as student venture initiatives
• Resourceful and self-directed; you don’t wait to be told where to look, but aren’t afraid to ask for help when you need it
• Genuine obsession with energy, climate tech, and industrial infrastructure — you read Canary Media, Heatmap, and Latitude Media, follow DOE funding announcements for fun, and of course frequently listen to Inevitable podcast!
• Strong builder instinct with software and data: comfortable navigating key databases (e.g., Pitchbook, Harmonic) with smart filtering, and excited to use AI tools to structure messy data and scale workflows rather than do everything by hand
• Excellent spoken and written communication — you can distill a complex deep-tech company into a clear, concise lunch-and-learn meeting, a memo, and you’re comfortable cold-emailing founders to get their attention
• Sound judgment: able to separate signal from noise and defend a point of view to a room of investors
• Experience building internal tools, scripts, or automations (even informally) to support a research or investment workflow
 Geography
 MCJ is a distributed team that primarily works remotely, but we have or are building hubs in geographies that are key to our sourcing engine, and this role needs to be in one of them. This includes: San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, Boston, and Austin.
 Interested in this job?
 Let the hiring team at MCJ contact you! Click I’m interested and enter your Linkedin profile and preferred contact information.

Contrary is a talent and research-driven investment firm, backed by some of the world’s most iconic entrepreneurs. We invest in a small number of exceptional people and the companies they build, and work closely alongside them to build enduring businesses from seed to scale.
 With this approach, we’ve backed iconic companies like Anduril, Ramp, Hallow, Zepto, and many others.
 Each year, we assemble a selective team of exceptional student Venture Partners (VPs) to partner closely with us and invest in the next generation of top founders. VPs hail from universities across the US and Canada, and are a group of top founders, builders, engineers, researchers, designers and writers.
 Being a Venture Partner
 As a Venture Partner, you'll be the go-to resource for founders and builders on campus. One day, you might grab coffee with someone brainstorming ideas for space manufacturing. The next, you'll research the latest AI trends or enterprise sales software as we evaluate relevant companies.
 You'll join a team of like-minded builders, learn how to think like an investor, and see what goes into starting and scaling a successful company.
 We look for independent thinkers with diverse experiences and a history of excellence.
 Previous VPs have started companies in high school, forgone careers as professional athletes, and built software projects with millions of users. There is no specific VP archetype. The only requirements are that you love tech and early-stage startups, and will put in the time and effort to make the most of the opportunity.
 All the details you'll need
 • We review applications as they come in, so apply now. The sooner the better. We have a final deadline of Sunday, September 13th at 11:59pm PT.
• We generally prefer people with more than one year of school left, but have made exceptions in the past.
• Our selection process includes 3 steps: an interview with a member of the Contrary HQ team, a more casual chat with existing VPs at your school (if applicable), and a conversation with our founder, Eric.
• Reach out to vp@contrary.com (vp@contrarycap.com) with any additional questions. We're always happy to chat and/or direct you to the appropriate resource.
• The Venture Partner role is a school-year commitment that lasts until you graduate. The community and network you join is life-long.

About Alumni Ventures 

 Alumni Ventures is one of the world’s most active venture capital platforms, with $1.4B+ in assets raised and investments in 1,600+ companies. Our network of 850,000+ members and 40+ dedicated investors connects accredited individuals to high-quality venture deals—typically reserved for institutions—through our alumni-driven communities and diversified co-investment strategy. With offices in Boston, New York, Chicago, Menlo Park, Manchester, NH, London and Tokyo we’re rapidly growing and committed to fueling entrepreneurial success while developing the next generation of VC professionals. 

 We believe our best work happens when we’re together. AV operates as a 5-day-a-week, in-office culture because collaboration, mentorship, and shared momentum matter. 

 About This Role 

 As an Investor Relations Associate at Alumni Ventures, you'll play a vital role in supporting our investor community while gaining hands-on exposure to venture capital, startup investing, investor relations, and fund operations. 

 This role sits at the intersection of customer success, relationship management, investor communications, and financial services. You'll work closely with prospective and existing investors, Managing Partners, Community Managers, and cross-functional teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor engagement activities, and operational processes. 

 You'll help individuals navigate their journey with Alumni Ventures—from initial interest through investment and ongoing engagement—while developing expertise in client service, investor relations, venture capital, and business operations. 

 This is an ideal opportunity for professionals who are eager to learn, take ownership, and grow their careers in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Through hands-on training, mentorship, and direct exposure to senior leadership, you'll build valuable skills in communication, relationship management, project management, operations, and venture investing. 

 While prior venture capital experience is not required, successful candidates are often interested in investing, entrepreneurship, startups, financial markets, or business strategy and are excited to learn about the venture capital ecosystem. 

 What You'll Do 

 Investor & Community Support 

• Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for prospective and existing investors. 

• Respond to investor questions through email, phone, webinars, events, and other communication channels. 

• Provide timely, accurate, and thoughtful support using approved resources and internal playbooks. 

• Help individuals navigate Alumni Ventures' offerings, processes, and community experience. 

 Investor Support and Community Operations 

• Build strong relationships with investors, community members, and internal stakeholders. 

• Deliver a high-touch, service-oriented customer experience across the investor journey. 

• Anticipate needs, identify issues, and help resolve questions with professionalism and empathy. 

• Support investor onboarding and ongoing engagement efforts. 

 Partner Support & Operations 

• Collaborate closely with Managing Partners, Community Managers, and senior leaders. 

• Support fundraising initiatives, fund operations, club programs, and syndication activities. 

• Assist with virtual events, investor meetings, webinar preparation, and follow-up activities. 

• Help ensure smooth execution of key investor engagement and operational processes. 

 Data, Reporting & Process Improvement 

• Track engagement activity, investor interactions, and key business metrics. 

• Help maintain clean and accurate data in HubSpot and other internal systems. 

• Support reporting for Community Managers, Partners, and leadership. 

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, communication, and the overall investor experience. 

 Strategic Projects 

• Participate in special projects and cross-functional initiatives. 

• Support research, process improvements, pilot programs, and team priorities. 

• Take on increasing ownership as your knowledge and experience grow. 

 Who You Are 

 We're looking for a client-centered, detail-oriented professional who is excited to grow in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 

 Required Qualifications 

• 1+ years of experience in customer success, client services, relationship management, account management, hospitality, recruiting, operations, financial services, consulting, or another customer-facing environment. 

• Effective written and verbal communication skills. 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through consistently. 

• Demonstrated ability to build positive relationships and provide thoughtful support to customers, or other stakeholders. 

• Ability to learn and effectively use new systems, tools, and business processes. 

• Interest in learning about investing, venture capital, financial markets, startups, or related business topics. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms. 

• Experience supporting clients, customers, members, investors, advisors, or other external stakeholders. 

• Exposure to financial services, investing, venture capital, wealth management, banking, consulting, or related industries. 

• Experience coordinating projects, events, webinars, or operational workflows. 

 A Note to Candidates 

 We recognize that talent comes from many backgrounds. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you'd be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed above. 

 Our Culture & How We Work at AV 
 Regardless of title, this is what great looks like at AV. 

• Put team and stakeholders first. We win together and measure success by the value we create for our investors, founders, and each other. 

• Take extreme ownership and bias toward action. We act like owners, move with urgency, and follow through. 

• Debate rigorously and commit fully. We welcome diverse views, use data and sound judgment, and once aligned, execute as one team. 

• Focus on what matters most. We prioritize impact, simplify where possible, and channel energy where we have a real advantage. 

• Be AI-forward and tech-optimistic. We actively use AI and emerging technologies to work smarter, make better decisions, and amplify human judgment — not replace it. 

• Stay curious and think big.  We are continuous learners, aim high and build for long-term impact. 

 Benefits & Perks 
 We offer a flexible, employee-first benefits program designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits begin shortly after hire and are designed to give you choice and flexibility based on your needs. 

• Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options, including employer-funded deductible support and HSA contributions 

• Dental and vision plans with multiple coverage tiers 

• Tax-advantaged accounts including HSA, FSA, and commuter benefits (with monthly employer contribution) 

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting 

• Company-paid life and disability insurance , plus optional supplemental coverage 

• Additional support programs including EAP, health advocacy, and wellness resources 

• Flexible, unlimited PTO and generous paid parental leave 

• 11 company holidays 

 Compensation 

 The annual base salary range for this position is $60,000 - $70,000.  In addition to base salary, eligible employees may receive equity, a corporate bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and programs. 
 Privacy Policy   

 All employment is subject to passing a background check. Alumni Ventures is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.
